blocks.text: Juby of Showtime Baby Dolls has been on the receiving end of criticism after talking about a dream she had that supposedly involved a sexual encounter with her celebrity crush, actor Donny Pangilinan. Juby revealed this during the girl group’s guesting on the Sunday, Oct. 18 episode of “Gandang Gabi, Vice,” after show host Vice Ganda the members’ respective crushes. “Para lang kay Donny ang giling-giling ko,” Juby sang, making a play on the lyrics of the group’s song “Oohh Lala Baby.” “Meme, may back story kasi ako sa kanya.
